fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation
fields.description: Nav document for this page (e.g. /jsw-nav). Leave empty for the site default /nav.

fields.name: footer
fields.label: Footer
fields.description: Footer document path, or "off" to hide the footer. Leave empty for the site default /footer.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Section Name
fields.description: The label shown for this section in the Content Tree

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Shown at the top of the card, between the arrows (e.g. OUR BLOGS).

fields.name: image
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Full-screen image behind the card; it fades in as the background turns dark. A soft, blurred image works best.

fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.description: Small line above the title, e.g. LEARN MORE / NEV & PHEV.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.description: The blog post the READ MORE bar opens.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: First paragraph: year (e.g. 1924). Then a heading for the title, then the description.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: The hero photo (cropped to fit, toned). JPG, PNG, WebP or SVG; other files are not shown.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Background image alt text
fields.description: Describes the photo for screen readers; empty if decorative.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: E.g. THE WORLD NEEDS PIONEERS.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Subheading / description
fields.description: Optional: a short paragraph under the heading.

fields.name: ctaLabel
fields.label: Button label
fields.description: E.g. SCROLL; empty for no button.

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: #open-roles scrolls to the Job Board; a page or URL opens it.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: E.g. OUR PERKS.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.description: Under the heading; new lines are kept.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: The line icon above the title.

fields.name: iconImage
fields.label: Custom icon image
fields.description: Optional: replaces the icon (square, ideally SVG). JPG, PNG, WebP or SVG; other files are not shown.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: E.g. Flexible hours. Up to 6 perks are shown.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Two or three short lines.

fields.name: media_imageAlt
fields.label: Image Alt
fields.description: Describe the artwork, e.g. 'New Delhi Experience Centre'

fields.name: media_mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile image (portrait, below 600px)
fields.description: Optional. Portrait artwork (e.g. 1080x1920) shown on phones.

fields.name: linkText
fields.label: Link Text
fields.description: Read by screen readers, e.g. 'New Delhi Experience Centre - Know more'

fields.name: media_mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile image (day, square, below 900px)
fields.description: Optional. Square transparent cut-out shown on phones/tablets.

fields.name: night_mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile image (night, square, below 900px)
fields.description: Optional. Square transparent cut-out shown on phones/tablets.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Variant A: word and car on a spotlight, text below. Variant B: image left, text right.

options.name: Variant A – Reserved (spotlight, word and car)
Variant B – All set (image beside the text)

fields.name: displayWord
fields.label: Background word
fields.description: Variant A only: the large word behind the car. Max 12 characters.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Status heading
fields.description: Wherever you add {name} in this field, it will be dynamically replaced with the name entered in the form. Max 64 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: {name}, {email} and {mobile} are replaced with the values entered in the form. Variant A: one line per sentence. Max 200 characters.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Variant A: the cut-out car. Variant B: the photo. JPG, PNG, WebP or SVG; other files are not shown.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image alt text
fields.description: Describes the image for screen readers. Max 64 characters.

fields.name: background
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Variant A only: the spotlight behind the word. JPG, PNG, WebP or SVG; other files are not shown.

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: Optional: a button under the description.

fields.name: ctaLinkText
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: The button's text. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.description: Stays at the top of the left column for every engine.

fields.name: media_image
fields.label: Engine image
fields.description: High-resolution image shown large on the right (hotspot positions are relative to it). Its alt text is generated from the engine type, e.g. "Battery Electric Vehicle engine".

fields.name: media_thumbnail
fields.label: Thumbnail image
fields.description: Shown on the thumbnail card (bottom left). Leave empty to use the engine image.

fields.name: media_framing
fields.label: Image framing
fields.description: Optional zoom and centre, e.g. "1.38 58% 52%": zoom relative to showing the whole image, then the image centre as left% top% of the display; add "flip" to mirror the image. Default: 1 50% 50%.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Engine type
fields.description: E.g. Battery Electric Vehicle. Also used for the engine image alt text and the thumbnail label.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Plain text shown under the engine type.

fields.name: hotspots
fields.label: Hotspots
fields.description: Up to 4 hotspots (any more are ignored), one paragraph each: position | TITLE | description, e.g. "18% 76% | INTELLIGENT SWITCHING | Automatically alternates…". Position is x y in % of the engine image, measured from its bottom-left corner ("18 76" works too). In the editor you can also drag a + on the image to move it: its position is saved here.

fields.name: mobileImage
fields.label: Mobile image (portrait, below 600px)
fields.description: Optional. Shown on phones instead of the main image.

fields.name: media_video
fields.label: Background video
fields.description: MP4 (H.264) or WebM file. Plays muted, looped and without controls.

fields.name: media_poster
fields.label: Poster image
fields.description: Shown while the video loads, when it can't play, and with reduced motion.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Headline and description
fields.description: A heading (top left) followed by a paragraph (bottom left).

fields.name: gallery
fields.label: Gallery image
fields.description: Optional: the photo strip under the board. JPG, PNG, WebP or SVG; other files are not shown.

fields.name: galleryAlt
fields.label: Gallery image alt text
fields.description: Describes the photo strip for screen readers.

fields.name: emptyMessage
fields.label: No results message
fields.description: Shown when nothing matches, e.g. No roles match your search.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: First line, in grey, e.g. OPEN ROLES AT.

fields.name: headingEmphasis
fields.label: Heading (second line)
fields.description: Second line, in black, e.g. JSW MOTORS.

fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Search input placeholder
fields.description: Inside the empty search box, e.g. Search Roles.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Under the search box.

fields.name: filterLabel
fields.label: Filters label
fields.description: Above the dropdowns, e.g. Filter Roles.

fields.name: locationLabel
fields.label: Location dropdown label
fields.description: The dropdown's label, e.g. Locations.

fields.name: locations
fields.label: Locations
fields.description: The dropdown's choices; empty: the jobs' own locations.

fields.name: departmentLabel
fields.label: Department dropdown label
fields.description: The dropdown's label, e.g. Departments.

fields.name: departments
fields.label: Departments
fields.description: The dropdown's choices; empty: the jobs' own departments.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Job title
fields.description: E.g. Embedded Software Engineer. Up to 15 jobs are shown.

fields.name: department
fields.label: Department
fields.description: One of the filter's departments, written the same way.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Job location
fields.description: E.g. Bangalore, India; separate several with semicolons.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Job description
fields.description: A short summary under the location (searchable).

fields.name: applyLink
fields.label: Apply button link
fields.description: A page, URL or mailto: address.

fields.name: applyLabel
fields.label: Apply button label
fields.description: E.g. APPLY NOW.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Variant A: columns at the right, over the background media; Variant B: one row on a teal gradient.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: The JSW MOTORS wordmark (white, on transparent): SVG, PNG or JPG.

fields.name: logoAlt
fields.label: Logo alt text
fields.description: E.g. JSW Motors.

fields.name: logoLink
fields.label: Logo link
fields.description: Where the logo leads, e.g. the home page.

fields.name: copyright
fields.label: Copyright
fields.description: E.g. © 2026 JSW Motors.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: E.g. Mumbai, India.

fields.name: ctaLabel
fields.label: Button label
fields.description: The white button's text, e.g. REGISTER INTEREST (a + follows it).

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: A page, URL or mailto: address; without a link the button is not shown.

fields.name: legalLink
fields.label: Legal link
fields.description: E.g. the privacy policy.

fields.name: legalLinkText
fields.label: Legal link label
fields.description: E.g. PRIVACY POLICY.

fields.name: backgroundMedia
fields.label: Background media
fields.description: Image, or a looping video with the image as its poster. Variant A only (ignored in Variant B).

fields.name: background
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: JPG or PNG; also the video's poster. Variant A only (ignored in Variant B).

fields.name: backgroundVideo
fields.label: Background video
fields.description: MP4 or MOV, used when Background media is Video. Variant A only (ignored in Variant B).

fields.name: socialHeading
fields.label: Social heading
fields.description: E.g. CONNECT, above the social icons (up to 4); in Variant B for screen readers only.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Column title
fields.description: E.g. TECHNOLOGY.

fields.name: link1
fields.label: Link 1
fields.description: A page, URL or mailto: address; without Link 1 text the link is not shown.

fields.name: link1Text
fields.label: Link 1 text
fields.description: E.g. NEVs; without Link 1 the link is not shown.

fields.name: link2
fields.label: Link 2
fields.description: A page, URL or mailto: address; without Link 2 text the link is not shown.

fields.name: link2Text
fields.label: Link 2 text
fields.description: Without Link 2 the link is not shown.

fields.name: link3
fields.label: Link 3
fields.description: A page, URL or mailto: address; without Link 3 text the link is not shown.

fields.name: link3Text
fields.label: Link 3 text
fields.description: Without Link 3 the link is not shown.

fields.name: link4
fields.label: Link 4
fields.description: A page, URL or mailto: address; without Link 4 text the link is not shown.

fields.name: link4Text
fields.label: Link 4 text
fields.description: Without Link 4 the link is not shown.

fields.name: network
fields.label: Network
fields.description: The icon and its screen-reader name; without a profile link the icon is not shown.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Profile link
fields.description: The network page URL; without a network the icon is not shown.

fields.name: position
fields.label: Position (optional)
fields.description: Optional. "large" marks the hero image that shrinks to the top (default: the first image). Images then fill screen 1 (4 cards) and screen 2 (4 cards) in order.

fields.name: background
fields.label: Background Image
fields.description: Fills the left half; a banner above the form on phones.

fields.name: backgroundAlt
fields.label: Background Image alt text
fields.description: Describes the image for screen readers. Max 64 characters.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The form's heading. Max 40 characters.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown under the heading. Max 200 characters.

fields.name: submitLabel
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: The button's text. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: submitAction
fields.label: Send the form to (URL)
fields.description: Where the data is posted as JSON; leave empty to send nothing. Max 256 characters.

fields.name: disclaimer
fields.label: Privacy disclaimer
fields.description: Small print under the button; an email address in it becomes a link, and the privacy link follows it. Max 200 characters.

fields.name: privacyLink
fields.label: Privacy notice link
fields.description: The privacy notice page.

fields.name: privacyLinkText
fields.label: Privacy notice link text
fields.description: The link's text. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: amountLabel
fields.label: Amount label
fields.description: The price card's label. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: amount
fields.label: Reservation amount (₹)
fields.description: In rupees; leave empty to hide the price card. Keep it the same as the payment service's amount.

fields.name: amountBadge
fields.label: Amount badge
fields.description: Optional tag beside the label. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: amountNote
fields.label: Amount note
fields.description: Shown under the amount. Max 200 characters.

fields.name: paymentService
fields.label: Payment service URL
fields.description: The service that creates and verifies payments; leave empty for test mode. The Key ID is in the block's configuration. Max 256 characters.

fields.name: merchantName
fields.label: Name in the payment window
fields.description: Shown in the payment window. Max 64 characters.

fields.name: successPage
fields.label: Page after the form is sent
fields.description: Opens once the form is sent and its payment confirmed (default: /confirmation).

fields.name: failurePage
fields.label: Page after a failed payment
fields.description: Opens after a failed payment (default: /payment-failed).

fields.name: pendingPreview
fields.label: Show pending state in the editor
fields.description: Shows the pending state in place of the form while editing, to edit its texts in place; never on the site.

fields.name: pendingHeading
fields.label: Pending title
fields.description: Shown while the payment is confirmed. Max 64 characters.

fields.name: pendingDescription
fields.label: Pending description
fields.description: Shown under the pending title. Max 200 characters.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown in the field; it also sets the field's kind. Max 64 characters.

fields.name: fieldName
fields.label: Field name
fields.description: The value's key in the sent data; leave empty to make it from the label. Max 64 characters.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown until a choice is made. Max 64 characters.

fields.name: fieldName
fields.label: Field name
fields.description: The choice's key in the sent data; leave empty to make it from the label. Max 64 characters.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Cities
fields.description: The choices, one per entry.

fields.name: option
fields.label: City
fields.description: Max 64 characters.
